entries.title: Psalms 86:1
segments: ¶<<A Prayer of David>> Bow down Your ear, O LORD, hear me; For I [am] poor and needy.

entries.title: Psalms 86:2
segments: Preserve my life, for I [am] holy; You are my God; Save Your servant who trusts in You!

entries.title: Psalms 86:3
segments: Be merciful to me, O Lord, For I cry to You all day long.

entries.title: Psalms 86:4
segments: Rejoice the soul of Your servant, For to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 86:5
segments: For You, Lord, [are] good, and ready to forgive, And abundant in mercy to all those who call upon You.

entries.title: Psalms 86:6
segments: Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer; And attend to the voice of my supplications.

entries.title: Psalms 86:7
segments: In the day of my trouble I will call upon You, For You will answer me.

entries.title: Psalms 86:8
segments: ¶Among the gods [there is] none like You, O Lord; Nor [are there any works] like Your works.

entries.title: Psalms 86:9
segments: All nations whom You have made Shall come and worship before You, O Lord, And shall glorify Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 86:10
segments: For You [are] great, and do wondrous things; You alone [are] God.

entries.title: Psalms 86:11
segments: Teach me Your way, O LORD; I will walk in Your truth; Unite my heart to fear Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 86:12
segments: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart, And I will glorify Your name forevermore.

entries.title: Psalms 86:13
segments: For great [is] Your mercy toward me, And You have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.

entries.title: Psalms 86:14
segments: O God, the proud have risen against me, And a mob of violent [men] have sought my life, And have not set You before them.

entries.title: Psalms 86:15
segments: But You, O Lord, [are] a God full of compassion, and gracious, Longsuffering and abundant in mercy and truth.

entries.title: Psalms 86:16
segments: Oh, turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give Your strength to Your servant, And save the son of Your maidservant.

entries.title: Psalms 86:17
segments: Show me a sign for good, That those who hate me may see [it] and be ashamed, Because You, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
